question: Who can join Zahara College of Skills?
answer: Our programmes are designed for women who want practical, career-oriented skills. Individual eligibility may vary by course; our team can guide you.

question: How do I choose the right course?
answer: Begin with the Career Explorer, then speak with our team. We will help you consider your interests, goals and the time you have available.

question: Are the programmes affordable?
answer: Affordability is one of Zahara's core commitments. Please contact us for the latest programme fees and available support.

question: How do I apply?
answer: You can start by sending an enquiry online or chatting with the admissions team on WhatsApp. We will explain the next steps clearly.
